title: Mitsubishi Electric CN105
description:
Controls a Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit through the CN105 service port (UART 2400 8E1, level shifter with its own 3.3 V LDO): virtual device in the Shelly app, HTTP endpoint, optional MQTT and Home Assistant. 
(Requires firmware version: 2.0.1 or newer)

title: Panasonic CN-CNT
description:
Reads and controls a Panasonic air-to-air indoor unit through the CN-CNT port, where the CZ-TACG1 adapter plugs in (UART 9600 8E1, level shifter with its own 3.3 V LDO): virtual device in the Shelly app with power consumption, HTTP endpoint, optional MQTT. Starts read-only. In development, tested on one unit. 
(Requires firmware version: 2.0.1 or newer)

title: Ouman EH-800B over USB
description:
Reads and controls an Ouman EH-800B heating controller through its USB service port with a CH376S USB-host module (HW-252) on the Pill UART: virtual components in the Shelly app, HTTP and MQTT. Install together with "Ouman EH-800B companion" on the same Pill. In development, bench-tested. 
(Requires firmware version: 2.0.1 or newer)

title: Ouman EH-800B companion
description:
Companion for "Ouman EH-800B over USB" on the same Pill: creates the virtual components, publishes Home Assistant MQTT discovery and reboots the Pill if the main script has stopped on an error. In development, bench-tested. 
(Requires firmware version: 2.0.1 or newer)
